//: Copy to foreman.config.json (gitignored) and fill in your own values. All fields optional — if none are set, Foreman prints escalations in chat only.

escalation.//: How Foreman reaches you on a Halt, a gate: human phase, exhausted retries, or completion. Foreman ALWAYS also prints the escalation in chat, so this is an enhancement, not a requirement.
escalation.//channel: One of: chat | discord. 'chat' = print in the Orchestrator session only. 'discord' = also ping the channel below (requires the Discord integration wired into your Claude Code).
escalation.//discord_channel_id: Primary Discord channel id to ping for escalations. Leave empty to disable.
escalation.//discord_dm_channel_id: Optional fallback DM channel id used if the primary channel fails.
